name: Badhaus
beschreibung: The Badhaus in Söll is a hotel offering comfortable accommodations in the Austrian region of Tyrol. Söll is situated in the Sölllandl area, part of the Tyrolean Unterland. The hotel is located in close proximity to the Wilder Kaiser mountain range. The facilities are tailored to the needs of vacationers, offering a variety of room categories. An appealing dining offering complements the stay. The property serves as an excellent starting point for exploring the surrounding region.
